mathematical_or_operational_scope: Exact n=8 lower spectral-minor polynomial Q over Z[z]/(z^4+1), affine in t and beta, with field-reduction comparisons.
positive_controls: Lines 57–69 require a nonzero polynomial, enforce the affine split Q=t*A+beta*B+C and require B nonzero as a polynomial.
Lines 83–89 compare every encoded coefficient against a separately built modular polynomial at two primes/two roots. Output labels necessity only.

findings.issue: The comment says hs includes indices 6 and 7, but four recurrence iterations starting from three values only compute indices 0..6. The implementation only uses 0..5 then substitutes hl; this is a documentation error, not an observed computational defect.

ours retains coefficients that reduce to zero whereas the modular polynomial drops zero terms. A valid reduction with a vanishing coefficient can fail dictionary equality spuriously. Normalize both maps by deleting zero coefficients.

The polynomial gate retains fixed-P8 chart assumptions and the B(h)=0 exceptional locus. Two-prime reductions are tests of implementation consistency, not an independent proof of every external support lemma or feasibility.
Depends on unreviewed-here arithmetic helpers and removable assertions. No external certificate parser is implemented.

cost_and_scaling: 24-term fixed 4x4 determinant over sparse polynomial dictionaries. Work grows with intermediate monomial counts/bit lengths, not a claimed n-asymptotic transform improvement.
test_scope_and_limits: Designed four finite-field coefficient comparisons. All source read, no imports or execution. Formal exact construction is visible, but helper implementations are not counted as read in this package.
certificate_acceptance: Q=0 is one necessary condition. B not being the zero polynomial does not authorize division at points with B(h)=0, and Q=0 does not imply a full factorization.
